summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 1, 2026, disclosing a press release that it is advancing its CyPath Lung test for surveillance of lung cancer survivors who have completed curative-intent treatment. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated. The filing notes more than 680,000 Americans with a prior lung cancer diagnosis and roughly 230,000 new diagnoses expected in 2026. This is a routine product-development update, not a special situation; watch for future clinical or regulatory milestones.
